objective: Test existing selective budget_feedback on an official task whose originally intended discovery tool is removed; compare all three course strategies plus original Selective Patch without adding prompt variants. Existing27 main results remain separate and unchanged.
hypothesis: Replacing removed search_symbols knowledge with the current browse_module query contract should avoid stale-tool calls while preserving requested explanation and concrete SwiftUI examples. Local sufficiency/budget rules may prevent redundant expansion. Either hypothesis can fail.

candidate.name: budget_feedback
candidate.implementation: existing deterministic patch, unchanged since previous cohorts
candidate.selection: Chosen for prior completion gains with known quality failures; not previously promoted. New task selected by mutation coverage before model outcomes, not by success.

quality_cases.provenance: Official selected task430; original question/server set unchanged. Selected for removal of intended search_symbols. No original answers/judge labels supplied to adaptation or execution.
required_properties: Explain declarative programming accurately and distinguish it from explicit imperative UI update steps.
Provide concrete SwiftUI examples that demonstrate state-driven declarative views and are internally consistent.
Use actual retrieved documentation/examples where claimed; distinguish retrieved snippets from newly composed examples and do not claim unperformed compilation.
Disclose retrieval failures or unsupported capabilities instead of inventing successful tool evidence.
forbidden: Treat a low error count as proof of task fulfillment.
Call model-written examples compiled or runtime verified without evidence.
Drop or rewrite the task to avoid the removed tool.
quality_cases.review: Inspect raw tool calls and returned source material, final explanation and code. Syntax compilation/runtime may remain unknown; no new scores or hidden rescoring.

evaluation.success_interpretation: Report observed gains and regressions by baseline and cell, with independent artifact review. No weighted metric, PE+0.5 requirement or automatic promotion. The goal still requires evidence of improved completion and task quality, not merely high judge scores.
evaluation.early: All four arms use exactK0. Differences at Early are stochastic, not adaptation gains.
evaluation.retention: Wikipedia catalog unchanged if snapshot verifies it; task235 remains the unchanged-task evidence in prior cohorts, not silently spliced as a new matched cell.
evaluation.repeat_limit: One execution per cell is a readiness/coverage pilot, not a three-repeat stability claim. No automatic81/108 expansion or low-score retries.
evaluation.decision_after_run: Review all12 raw trajectories before further design. If the predicted mechanism is absent or quality fails, record the negative result. Any next work must address a specific remaining gap.

fairness.actual_provider: DigitalOcean only for updater/agent/judge; no fallback
fairness.agent_budget: 4096 output tokens,12 rounds,900s execution,120s request,30s tools
fairness.judge: Five original first-valid slots, fixed model/decoding/rubric and concise-counts-v1 recovery
fairness.updater: 16384 tokens,temperature0,reasoning disabled,JSON; whole target catalog for FR, deterministic selective methods. Same model, actual-provider route and cost accounting. Extra updater config fields do not change historical defaults.
fairness.source_control: All code/config/knowledge frozen before agent execution; opaque cell IDs. No task content or scores enter updater.
fairness.network_limit: Original released read-only MCP services access live public Wikipedia/Swiftipedia. Archive observations and timestamps. Remote content is not frozen and may vary; do not claim exact future content or broader causal certainty.
fairness.full_rewrite_scope: Rebuild every record from target catalog, rewrite all descriptions by LLM, preserve target schemas/routing/output schema and supplied usage rules. Same disclosed interpretation as main benchmark, not a newly validated all-fields LLM rewrite.

original_task_retention: Do not replace133/235/283, remove failures, merge different protocols into one mean, or relabel this expansion as the frozen27-run course main benchmark.
